entries.appliesTo: nonhuman entities, including agents powered by artificial intelligence, seeking licensure or using professional titles in nursing, medicine, or as physician assistants

sources.aiPracticeRule: § 1920(h), Title 24 — 'A nonhuman entity, including an agent powered by artificial intelligence, may not be licensed in any of the following'; § 1720(k), Title 24 — 'A nonhuman entity, including an agent powered by artificial intelligence, may not be certified to practice medicine in the State.'
sources.scope: § 1773(d), Title 24 — 'A nonhuman entity, including an agent powered by artificial intelligence, may not be licensed as a physician assistant in the State.'

flags: Title-use prohibition fits no listed duty: § 1920(i) — 'A nonhuman entity, including an agent powered by artificial intelligence, may not use any of the following titles or abbreviations' (parallel prohibitions in § 1720(l) and § 1773(d) covering 'Doctor'/'Dr.', 'Physician or surgeon', 'MD', 'DO', nursing titles, and 'PA').
No penalty or enforcement provision in this text; exposure omitted (silence is silence).
Prohibition only — bill imposes no ongoing compliance program on licensed human providers or operators.
Text on file is the Introduced version (per corpus caveat in CLAUDE.md); LegiScan status Passed 2026-04-23, no substitution relation found.
